name: FinancialAidAwardViewer
tagline: Turn the financial aid offer into an interactive award letter with live net price.
description: PCF code component for student portals: cost of attendance, grants, scholarships, work-study and loans with accept / reduce / decline per award, net price and estimated bill, per-term disbursements, loan requirement holds, response deadline countdown and a validated submit flow. Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Accept / Reduce / Decline per award with min/max validation
Live net price and estimated bill or refund
Gift aid vs self-help grouping with term split
Loan net disbursement and requirement holds
Over-award and missing-decision validation with acknowledgement and submit
Requirements checklist and cost of attendance breakdown
Phone layout with sticky net price and Submit bar
19 outputs and a browser change event
Configurable labels, currency, locale and colours
